## Requirement

<a id="BreathOfMove"></a>

### Rising on a breath in

`BreathOfMove` · `src/composing.ts:28` · status: **held**

The phase of the breath a body moves on from one pose to the next: it breathes in when it rises and opens (the head and the hands higher, on average), and breathes out when it lowers and folds, or does not move.

<details><summary>The rule, in the code</summary>

```typescript
({ keyOf, bodyAt, g, counts }) => (from: Shape, to: Shape): BreathPhase => {
    const height = (s: Shape) => {
      const k = keyOf(s)
      const b = bodyAt(k, k, counts.zero)
      const raised = [b.head, b.L.wrist, b.R.wrist]
      return raised.reduce<number>((sum, p) => sum + g.height(p), counts.zero) / raised.length
    }
    return height(to) > height(from) ? BreathPhase.inhale : BreathPhase.exhale
  }
```

</details>

- Owner: ghalaax
- Parameters: `keyOf` ← [A pose ready to move](body.md#KeyOf) · `bodyAt` ← [The body between two poses](body.md#BodyAt) · `g` ← [The space of the mat](body.md#MatSpace) · `counts` ← [Counts](../.trame/std/docs/algebra.md#Counts)
- Refines: [Practise yoga on one's own, guided](product.md#PractiseGuided)
- Used by: [A sequence composed](#ComposedSequence)
- Verified by: [Sequences drawn by lot](scenarios.md#DrawnSequencesMakeSense)

<a id="HoldingDefaults"></a>

### What a composed practice holds

`HoldingDefaults` · `src/composing.ts:64`

How many poses a composed practice has (eight, from three to twelve: going down to the floor and back up, one foot at a time, takes seven) and how many breaths each is held (five, from one to twenty); a sequence learnt holds each pose three breaths.

| Case | Value |
|---|---|
| count | 8 |
| fewest | 3 |
| most | 12 |
| breaths | 5 |
| least | 1 |
| longest | 20 |
| learning | 3 |

- Decided by: ghalaax
- Rejected: Holds in seconds, the breath sets the pace: a hold lasts whole breaths, whatever the person's breath

<a id="DrawnSequence"></a>

### A sequence drawn by lot

`DrawnSequence` · `src/composing.ts:78` · status: **held**

Poses drawn one after the other with the seeded draws of the standard library: it starts at a standing pose; each next pose keeps the sequence sensible and near enough to standing to end there with the poses left; a pose not yet drawn, at another level, is likelier. A draw that runs into a dead end takes back its last pose and draws another, so that it always ends standing. Of several draws, the most varied is kept (the most poses and levels it visits): eight poses go down to the floor and come back up rather than stay standing. It touches nothing.

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `unseen` | `3` | How much likelier a pose not yet drawn is |
| `newLevel` | `4` | How much likelier a pose at another level is |
| `tries` | `12` | How many draws are made, of which the most varied is kept |

- Owner: ghalaax
- Parameters: `draws` ← [Seeded draws](../.trame/std/docs/algorithms.md#SeededDraws) · `ways` ← [The ways between levels](content.md#LevelWays) · `sense` ← [A sequence that makes sense](content.md#MakesSense) · `counts` ← [Counts](../.trame/std/docs/algebra.md#Counts)
